Provision for Income Taxes

Provision for income taxes, effective tax rate and statutory federal income tax rate for the three- and six-month periods ended March 29, 2025 and March 30, 2024 were as follows (dollars in millions):

| | Three Months Ended | | Six Months Ended | |

| Effective tax rate | 15.5% | 15.8% | 15.0% | 15.8% |
| Statutory federal income tax rate | 21% | 21% | 21% | 21% |

The Company’s effective tax rate for the second quarter of 2025 was lower than the statutory federal income tax rate due primarily to a lower effective tax rate on foreign earnings, including the impact of changes in unrecognized tax benefits, partially offset by state income taxes.
